**Finding: compliant (preferred position met).**

The Agreement contains no non-solicitation, no-hire, or anti-poaching covenant binding Meridian Fieldworks. Targeted searches for "solicit", "employ or engage", "induce … to leave", "no-hire", "hire", "personnel", and restrictive-covenant language surfaced only:

- **§ 12.3 (p0049)** — affirmatively preserves Customer's freedom to hire "any person who responds to general recruitment" and records that "Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment."
- **§ 30.1 (p0116)** — a bare independent-contractor clause with no hiring or solicitation restriction.

This satisfies the preferred element ("Customer has no non-solicitation restriction"), so there is no need to negotiate down to the mutual 12-month fallback and no redline was proposed.
